description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DocumentPopupPicker' that extends 'Popup_Picker' to generate a popup interface for selecting documents based on certain filters. It includes logic for handling search queries, rendering a form, and listing documents in a view. It is part of the SuiteCRM (a CRM extension) and interacts with the application's UI components, data models, and global variables.

classes.name: DocumentPopupPicker
classes.description: A class extending Popup_Picker that provides specialized functionality to filter and select documents within a popup, including constructing SQL WHERE clauses based on request parameters.
